_note: Corrections to the Wikipedia film data, applied by scripts/gen-bacon-graph.py. drop_films: TV movies, compilation documentaries, re-cuts and other rows that are not ordinary theatrical films. drop_cast: a name the source lists for a film the person is not in. add_cast: a principal player the source left out. add_films: a film the source left out entirely, [title, year, [cast in billing order]]. set_year: [title, source year, release year]. chain_avoid: a real but uncredited or cameo credit that may be played but is never shown in an ending chain (read by scripts/gen-bacon.py). Add a line when a player or reviewer reports one, then rebuild the graph and re-run scripts/verify-bacon.mjs.
